description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - cue fridge: look at the fridge and hold steady to trigger the to-fetch checklist, tick off one item as you take it, mark out-of-stock items that do not count as missed, and before closing it names any still-unticked items out loud (a reminder, not a gate); ticking is the user's own statement, not a sensor proof; session memory only.
name: cue-fridge
